stopPoints.label: Looking out the window
stopPoints.question:
Question (Weather): 'Look out the window! Is it raining 🌧️ or sunny ☀️?'
Options: 'A) It's raining. B) It's sunny.'
Guidance: 'The sun is out! It's sunny!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa and George running outside
stopPoints.question:
Question (Emotion): 'Are Peppa and George happy 😊 or sad 😢?'
Options: 'A) Happy. B) Sad.'
Guidance: 'Yes! They are very happy to go outside!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa jumping in the mud
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'What is Peppa doing?'
Options: 'A) Sleeping 🛏️ B) Jumping 🦘'
Guidance: 'She is jumping! Jump, jump, jump!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa wearing her boots
stopPoints.question:
Question (Clothes): 'What is Peppa wearing on her feet?'
Options: 'A) Yellow boots 👢 B) Red shoes 👞'
Guidance: 'She is wearing yellow boots! Can you say "yellow boots"?'

stopPoints.label: George wants to jump
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Does George have his boots on?'
Options: 'A) Yes, he does. B) No, he doesn't.'
Guidance: 'No, he doesn't! He needs his boots to jump!'

stopPoints.label: Finding more puddles
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Who is walking with Peppa?'
Options: 'A) George 🐷 B) Daddy Pig 👓'
Guidance: 'It's her little brother, George!'

stopPoints.label: A big muddy puddle
stopPoints.question:
Question (Size): 'Look at the puddle! Is it big 🐘 or small 🐭?'
Options: 'A) Big B) Small'
Guidance: 'Wow! It's a very BIG puddle!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa checks the puddle
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Is the puddle safe for George?'
Options: 'A) Yes, it is! B) No, it isn't.'
Guidance: 'Yes, it is! Peppa checked it. Let's jump!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa and George are muddy
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Look at Peppa and George! Are they clean ✨ or dirty 🤎?'
Options: 'A) Clean B) Dirty'
Guidance: 'They are very dirty! They have mud everywhere!'

stopPoints.label: Running back home
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'Where are they running to?'
Options: 'A) To the park 🌳 B) Into the house 🏠'
Guidance: 'They are running into the house to show Daddy!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig guesses
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Did Peppa and George just have a bath? 🛁'
Options: 'A) Yes, they did. B) No, they didn't.'
Guidance: 'No, they didn't! They were playing in the mud!'

stopPoints.label: Cleaning up
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color): 'What color is the sponge Daddy Pig is using?'
Options: 'A) Blue 🔵 B) Yellow 🟡'
Guidance: 'It's a yellow sponge! Rub-a-dub-dub!'

stopPoints.label: Family jumping in mud
stopPoints.question:
Question (Family): 'Who is jumping with Peppa and George now?'
Options: 'A) Mummy and Daddy Pig 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 B) Grandpa Pig 👴'
Guidance: 'Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are jumping too!'

stopPoints.label: Everyone falls in the mud
stopPoints.question:
Question (Emotion): 'Are they crying 😭 or laughing 😂?'
Options: 'A) Crying B) Laughing'
Guidance: 'They are laughing! Everyone loves muddy puddles!'
